verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government tax service with online filing and data portals, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the Comptroller ships a CLI. Its surfaces are the Webfile/eSystems web portal, phone filing, PDF forms, EDI and third-party preparer software. The keyless Socrata JSON endpoint on data.texas.gov is a host-platform data API, not a first-party CLI, so it earns no credit.
